text_en: Move the black cup from the right side to the middle position.
text_zh: 将右侧的黑色杯子移动到中间位置。

text_en: Place chrysanthemum into the black cup.
Use the left hand to pick up the white cup on the left.
text_zh: 用左手拿起左侧的白色水杯。

text_en: Use the right hand to pick up and steady the black cup for pouring.
text_zh: 用右手拿起并稳住黑色杯子，准备倒水。

text_en: Pour water from the white cup into the black cup, then return the robot to its home pose.
text_zh: 将白色水杯里的水倒入黑色杯子，完成后机器人姿态回正。
